name: send_message
description:
Send a new email directly from the user's Outlook account. The email is sent immediately.

IMPORTANT: This action is IRREVERSIBLE. Once sent, the email cannot be unsent.

Use this tool when the user asks you to send an email. For composing without sending,
use outlook_create_draft instead.

This is also the tool for replying to a SPECIFIC person (not reply-all). To reply to the
sender only (or a subset of recipients):
1. First use outlook_get_message to read the original message
2. Set to: [sender's email] (only the people you want to reply to)
3. Set reply_to_message_id to the original message's internet_message_id (NOT the message_id)
4. Set conversation_id to the original message's conversation_id
5. The subject should start with 'Re: ' followed by the original subject

For replying to ALL recipients, use outlook_reply_all instead.

to.description: List of recipient email addresses (To field)

cc.description: List of CC recipient email addresses (optional)

bcc.description: List of BCC recipient email addresses (optional)

body.description: Plain text body of the email

body_html.description: Optional: HTML body. If provided, email body is set as HTML content type.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional: RFC Message-ID for threading replies (use internet_message_id from outlook_get_message, NOT the message_id). Sets In-Reply-To header.

conversation_id.description: Optional: conversation ID to keep the reply in the same thread
